summary: This is a Phase 1 study to test the effects of a drug called tirzepatide on markers related to colorectal cancer risk. The study is sponsored by Massachusetts General Hospital and aims to enroll 20 people who are currently Recruiting. Researchers will look at tissue, urine, blood, and microbiome samples to see how the drug affects the body. A colonoscopy is part of the background requirement for participants aged 18 to 50 years.
